### Service
Issuance of Official Receipt for Real Property Tax

### Who may avail
All property taxpayers.

### Requirements
Previous tax receipt(s) or Tax Declaration(s), original copy, from the taxpayer or City Assessor's Office.

### Steps

1. Get a priority number.
2. Submit the documents at CTO Windows 1-2.
3. Pay the assessed amount at Windows 3-5.
4. Claim and keep the Official Receipt.

### Fee / Tax basis
Assessed Value x 1% x number of years x 2, covering Basic Tax and Special Education Fund.

### Processing time
4 hours

### Source
10Citizens-Charter_CTO-2026.pdf, Citizens' Charter pages 425-426.
tl_answer:
### Serbisyo
Pag-isyu ng Official Receipt para sa Real Property Tax

### Sino ang maaaring mag-avail
Lahat ng property taxpayers.

### Mga kailangan
Original na previous tax receipt(s) o Tax Declaration(s), mula sa taxpayer o City Assessor's Office.

### Proseso

1. Kumuha ng priority number.
2. Isumite ang dokumento sa CTO Windows 1-2.
3. Bayaran ang assessed amount sa Windows 3-5.
4. Kunin at itago ang Official Receipt.

### Bayad / Batayan ng buwis
Assessed Value x 1% x bilang ng taon x 2, para sa Basic Tax at Special Education Fund.

### Oras ng proseso
4 oras

### Source
10Citizens-Charter_CTO-2026.pdf, Citizens' Charter pages 425-426.

en_answer:
### Real Property Tax Due Date
The CTO 2026 Citizens' Charter states that real property tax is an annual tax, but it does not provide the annual or quarterly payment deadlines. It only documents the payment procedure, tax basis, and four-hour processing time.

For an exact deadline, penalty cut-off, or discount period, request the current schedule from the City Treasurer's Office. Bring the Tax Declaration number or current/previous tax receipt so CTO can also prepare a Statement of Account.

### Source
10Citizens-Charter_CTO-2026.pdf, Citizens' Charter pages 425-426 and 437.
tl_answer:
### Takdang Petsa ng Real Property Tax
Nakasaad sa CTO 2026 Citizens' Charter na taunang buwis ang real property tax, ngunit walang ibinigay na annual o quarterly payment deadlines. Payment procedure, tax basis, at apat na oras na processing time lamang ang nakasaad.

Para sa eksaktong deadline, penalty cut-off, o discount period, kunin ang kasalukuyang schedule sa City Treasurer's Office. Dalhin ang Tax Declaration number o current/previous tax receipt para makapagbigay din ang CTO ng Statement of Account.

### Source
10Citizens-Charter_CTO-2026.pdf, Citizens' Charter pages 425-426 at 437.

### Service
Renewal of Business Permit - Walk-in

### Who may avail
Existing and operating businesses in Panabo City.

### Requirements
Notarized sworn declaration of gross sales/receipts or preceding-year ITR/AFS; notarized employee/no-employee certification; valid FSIC; and applicable documents for government-facility businesses, lessees, regulated activities, and representatives.

### Steps

1. Submit complete requirements to CMO-BPLS and obtain the Assessment Form/Order of Payment.
2. Pay at CTO and secure the Official Receipt.
3. Present the receipt and document copies at BPLS Window 3 and obtain a claim stub.
4. Claim the renewed permit, sticker, barangay clearance, and sanitary permit.

### Fees
Based on City Ordinance No. 04-09, gross receipts/business classification, and the applicable barangay ordinance.

### Processing time
8 hours; multi-stage processing.

### Source
1Citizens-Charter_CMO-2026 3.pdf, Citizens' Charter pages 64-69.

### Service
Retirement of Business Permit

### Who may avail
A business owner discontinuing operations.

### Requirements
BPLS application form; Affidavit of Retirement; audited financial statements for three calendar years; current original Mayor's Permit; business plate; Barangay Certification that the business is no longer operating; and applicable corporate, non-operation, market, representative, or loss documents.

### Steps

1. Submit complete documents to CMO-BPLS.
2. BPLS inspects and verifies the business status.
3. Present the verified retirement documents to CTO for assessment and payment.
4. Return the Official Receipt and documents to BPLS Window 2 and obtain a claim stub.
5. Claim the approved retirement action.

### Fees
PHP 80 surrender fee plus applicable taxes and late-retirement penalties. Retirement should be filed within 30 days of closure.

### Processing time
2 days and 5 hours.

### Source
1Citizens-Charter_CMO-2026 3.pdf, Citizens' Charter pages 125-128.

### Proseso

1. Isumite ang dokumento sa CMO-BPLS.
2. Iinspeksyunin at ive-verify ang business status.
3. Dalhin ang verified documents sa CTO para sa assessment at payment.
4. Ibalik ang Official Receipt at documents sa BPLS Window 2 at kunin ang claim stub.

### Bayad

2 araw at 5 oras.

### Service
Releasing of Impounded Vehicle

### Who may avail
Owners/proprietors of impounded colorum four-wheeled vehicles, tricycles, motorcycles, or trisikads.

### Requirements
Citation ticket/impounding receipt; Driver's License OR/payment and undertaking; OR/CR or proof of ownership; helmet for motorcycle; original Mayor's Permit for trisikad driver.

### Steps
Submit requirements at CMO-TMDS, attend the City Traffic Code seminar held every Tuesday and Thursday, complete attendance, then receive the vehicle and sign the logbook.

### Fees
None for this service.

### Processing time
1 hour 20 minutes, excluding waiting for the scheduled seminar day.

### Source
1Citizens-Charter_CMO-2026 3.pdf, Citizens' Charter pages 203-204.

### Service
Issuance of Building Permit

### Who may avail
All owners/applicants undertaking covered construction work.

### Requirements
Six notarized Unified Building Permit forms; title, tax declaration and tax clearance; five signed/sealed plan sets; cost estimates and specifications; structural analysis and soil test when applicable; FSEC; locational and barangay clearances; professional PTR/PRC/TIN; and ownership/authority documents when applicable.

### Steps
Submit to the City Building Official's Office, undergo assessment/site inspection, pay the Order of Payment at CTO, obtain FSEC from BFP, resubmit the complete package for technical evaluation and approval, then claim the permit and plans.

### Fees
Per Annex A of NBCDO Memorandum Circular No. 03, series of 2016; amount is project-based.

### Processing time
22 working days, 3 hours 35 minutes; multi-stage.

### Source
1Citizens-Charter_CMO-2026 3.pdf, Citizens' Charter pages 205-208.

### Proseso
Isumite sa City Building Official's Office, dumaan sa assessment/site inspection, magbayad sa CTO, kumuha ng FSEC sa BFP, muling isumite ang complete package para sa technical evaluation at approval, at kunin ang permit at plans.

### Bayad
Ayon sa Annex A ng NBCDO Memorandum Circular No. 03, series of 2016; project-based ang halaga.

### Oras ng proseso
22 working days, 3 oras 35 minuto; multi-stage.

### Source
1Citizens-Charter_CMO-2026 3.pdf, Citizens' Charter pages 205-208.

Expiration: The permit is granted for a period of not more than one (1) year. It will legally expire on the thirty-first (31st) of December following the date of issuance, unless it is revoked or surrendered earlier.

Any property owner or authorized representative.

- Requester's government ID with 3 specimen signatures (1 photocopy)

5 working days

Tax Declaration and Notice of Assessment

### Fees
Here is the structured, step-by-step procedure you will follow to secure your New Business Permit, which takes a total processing time of 8 hours:

Step 1: Submission and Assessment at BPLS

Submit all your complete documentary requirements to the Business Permit and Licensing Section (BPLS).

The BPLS will evaluate your application, encode your profile into their system, and endorse it for assessment.

Goal: Make sure to secure the issued Assessment Form and Order of Payment before moving to the next step.

Step 2: Payment at the City Treasurer's Office (CTO)

Proceed to the CTO, secure a priority number from the queuing machine, and wait to be called.

Fee Computation: The fees you must pay are based on the Local Tax Code (depending on your gross receipts and the classification of your business) and the Identified Barangay Ordinance for the corresponding Barangay Clearance Fee.

Step 3: Processing and Releasing

After paying, present your Official Receipt with a photocopy of your documents and secure a claim stub at BPLS window no. 3.

Your permit will undergo final review and will be signed by the Local Chief Executive (taking up to 2 hours).

Once finalized, you will receive your Business Permit, business plate, barangay clearance, sanitary permit, and locational clearance. You must sign the logbook upon receipt.
tl_answer:
### Bayarin
Narito ang structured, step-by-step na procedure na iyong susundin para ma-secure ang iyong New Business Permit, na tumatagal ng kabuuang oras ng pagproseso na 8 oras:

Hakbang 1: Pagsusumite at Pagsusuri sa BPLS

Isumite ang lahat ng iyong kumpletong dokumentaryo na kinakailangan sa Business Permit and Licensing Section (BPLS).

Susuriin ng BPLS ang iyong aplikasyon, i-encode ang iyong profile sa kanilang system, at ieendorso ito para sa pagtatasa.

Layunin: Tiyaking i-secure ang ibinigay na Assessment Form at Order of Payment bago lumipat sa susunod na hakbang.

Hakbang 2: Pagbabayad sa City Treasurer's Office (CTO)

Magpatuloy sa CTO, kumuha ng priority number mula sa queuing machine, at maghintay na matawagan.

Pagkalkula ng Bayad: Ang mga bayarin na dapat mong bayaran ay nakabatay sa Local Tax Code (depende sa iyong mga kabuuang resibo at klasipikasyon ng iyong negosyo) at ang Natukoy na Barangay Ordinance para sa kaukulang Barangay Clearance Fee.

Hakbang 3: Pagproseso at Pagpapalabas

Pagkatapos magbayad, ipakita ang iyong Opisyal na Resibo kasama ang isang photocopy ng iyong mga dokumento at kumuha ng claim stub sa BPLS window no. 3.

Ang iyong permit ay sasailalim sa panghuling pagsusuri at pipirmahan ng Lokal na Punong Tagapagpaganap (tatagal ng hanggang 2 oras).

Kapag natapos na, matatanggap mo ang iyong Business Permit, business plate, barangay clearance, sanitary permit, at locational clearance. Dapat mong lagdaan ang logbook kapag natanggap.

### Service
Availment of Limited Financial Assistance

### Who may apply
An indigent individual in a crisis situation in Panabo City.

### Assistance
Up to PHP 1,200, subject to the assigned worker's assessment of urgency and need. A person may avail once every three months.

### Requirements
- Barangay Certificate stating that the client is in a crisis situation (1 original), from the Barangay Hall
- Government-issued ID showing the Panabo City address of the client/person to be interviewed, with contact number (1 photocopy)
- For medical assistance: Medical Certificate or Certificate of Confinement issued within five days, bearing the attending physician's complete name, signature, and license number (original)
- For medicine assistance: Medical Prescription issued within five days, with a pharmacy quotation and the physician's complete name, signature, and license number (original)
- Government-issued ID of the claimant and contact number

### Steps

1. Submit the complete requirements at the CSWDO Family, Community and Emergency Section.
2. Answer the Intake Sheet and attend the intake interview and assessment.
3. Wait while the acknowledgment receipt and supporting documents are prepared and approved by the Department Head.
4. Receive the cash assistance, then sign the acknowledgment receipt and logbook.

### Fee
None

### Processing time
2 hours and 5 minutes

### Source
14Citizens-Charter_CSWDO-2026.pdf, Citizens' Charter pages 567-569.

department: CMO – Business Permit and Licensing Section
en_answer:
The barangay clearance fee for a business is not one fixed amount. Under the City Mayor’s Office Citizens’ Charter, it depends on the barangay ordinance and may also depend on the business type, capitalization or gross sales, and whether the application is new or for renewal.

To check the applicable fee, please tell me:

1. The barangay where the business is located
2. The type of business
3. Whether this is a new application or renewal
4. The capitalization or previous-year gross sales, if the barangay’s schedule uses it

For example, the Charter lists ₱75 for a business permit in A.O. Floirendo, ₱100 in Cacao, and tiered fees in Cagangohan and Gredu. These are examples only; your correct fee must follow the ordinance for your barangay and business classification. The final assessment is issued during the business-permit process.

### Source
1Citizens-Charter_CMO-2026 5.pdf, Annex B, PDF pages 22–25
tl_answer:
Walang iisang nakapirming halaga ang barangay clearance fee para sa negosyo. Ayon sa Citizens’ Charter ng City Mayor’s Office, nakadepende ito sa ordinansa ng barangay at maaari ring magbago batay sa uri ng negosyo, kapital o gross sales, at kung bago o renewal ang aplikasyon.

Para matukoy ang naaangkop na bayad, pakibigay ang:

1. Barangay kung saan matatagpuan ang negosyo
2. Uri ng negosyo
3. Kung bagong aplikasyon o renewal
4. Kapital o gross sales noong nakaraang taon, kung ginagamit ito sa fee schedule ng barangay

Halimbawa, nakasaad sa Charter ang ₱75 para sa business permit sa A.O. Floirendo, ₱100 sa Cacao, at magkakaibang antas ng bayad sa Cagangohan at Gredu. Mga halimbawa lamang ito; ang tamang bayad ay dapat sundin ang ordinansa ng inyong barangay at klasipikasyon ng negosyo. Ang pinal na assessment ay ibinibigay sa proseso ng business permit.

### Source
1Citizens-Charter_CMO-2026 5.pdf, Annex B, PDF pages 22–25
bis_answer:
Walay usa ka pirming kantidad ang barangay clearance fee para sa negosyo. Sumala sa Citizens’ Charter sa City Mayor’s Office, magdepende kini sa ordinansa sa barangay ug mahimo usab nga magkalahi base sa klase sa negosyo, kapital o gross sales, ug kung bag-o ba o renewal ang aplikasyon.

Aron matino ang hustong bayranan, palihog ihatag ang:

1. Barangay diin nahimutang ang negosyo
2. Klase sa negosyo
3. Kung bag-ong aplikasyon o renewal
4. Kapital o gross sales sa miaging tuig, kung gigamit kini sa fee schedule sa barangay

Pananglitan, gilista sa Charter ang ₱75 para sa business permit sa A.O. Floirendo, ₱100 sa Cacao, ug lain-laing lebel sa bayad sa Cagangohan ug Gredu. Here’s the official CCRO guidance for registering a birth, marriage, or death certificate.

### What you need
- Birth: four original Certificates of Live Birth, parents’ Marriage Certificate, and official receipt. For an illegitimate child, additional IDs and affidavits may apply. For delayed registration, provide the PSA/LCR Certificate of No Record, an Affidavit of Delayed Registration, and supporting evidence.
- Marriage: four original Marriage Certificates, application and Marriage License copies, and the solemnizing officer’s CRASM when applicable. Delayed registration requires a reconstructed/accomplished certificate, affidavits, PSA/LCR no-record certifications, and available supporting records.
- Death: four original Certificates of Death, the informant’s ID or cedula, and medical or barangay certification. Medico-legal cases require a police report. Delayed registration requires cemetery/tombstone evidence, burial record, church certification, and PSA/LCR no-record certification.

### Steps

1. Complete the information sheet and submit all applicable documents to CCRO.
2. Receive the Order of Payment and pay at the City Treasurer’s Office; keep the official receipt.
3. Return to CCRO, submit the receipt, and undergo image/biometric registration.
4. Claim the owner’s copy after review, approval, and registry-number assignment.

### Fees
- Timely birth or death registration: Free
- Timely marriage certificate registration: ₱250
- Late birth, marriage, or death registration: ₱450
- Certified true copy: ₱60 per copy
The Charter’s total row shows ₱760 by combining listed fee categories; the amount you pay depends on your transaction and the issued Order of Payment.

### Processing time
2 hours and 35 minutes

### Office
City Civil Registrar’s Office

### Processing time

### Sino ang maaaring kumuha
Indigent individuals in a crisis situation who need physician-prescribed medicine.

### Mga kinakailangan
Original barangay certificate stating residence, purpose, and crisis situation; government ID showing Panabo City address/contact number; original Medical Certificate/Abstract or confinement certificate issued within five days; prescription issued within five days with pharmacy quotation; and claimant’s valid ID.

### Proseso
Submit documents at the Family, Community and Emergency Section; undergo intake assessment; CSWDO determines the approved amount and prepares acknowledgement records; receive cash/medicine assistance and sign the receipt/logbook.

### Bayarin / Tulong
No application fee. Maximum medicine assistance is ₱3,000 every three months under City Ordinance No. 07-2024, subject to assessment.

### Oras ng proseso
2 hours and 20 minutes.

### Tanggapan
City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO)

### Source
14Citizens-Charter_CSWDO-2026.pdf, PDF pages 35–37
